portfolio.

From foundational B1 trade vocabulary to advanced C1 strategy and policy discourse, every module is anchored in real-world international trade scenarios — from customs clearance to global sourcing, from trade finance to market expansion. Built for use inside trading companies, logistics firms, multinational corporations, and global commerce teams.
